title: Cleaning Service Estimate Template
subtitle: An estimate pre-filled for residential or commercial cleaning — standard visits, deep cleans, windows, carpet, move-out and supplies. Download as Excel (auto-calculating), Word, or PDF.
taxHint: Look up your state's sales tax rate
paymentTerms: Estimate valid for 30 days. A 25% deposit secures the first scheduled visit; balance due after service.
notes: This is an estimate, not a final invoice. Recurring weekly / bi-weekly service billed at the standard visit rate unless add-ons are requested.
features: Auto-calculating totals and 25% deposit in Excel
Pre-filled cleaning line items: standard visits, deep cleans, windows, carpet, move-out, supplies
Valid-until date + deposit section standard for cleaning quotes
Recurring service note helps set weekly / bi-weekly expectations up front

faqs.q: What should I include on a cleaning service estimate?
faqs.a: At minimum: your business name, the client and property address, a dated line-item list (visits, deep clean, windows, carpet, move-out), a validity date, deposit terms, and a note that it is not a final invoice.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All three formats (PDF, Word, Excel) are free to download with no email required.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate the deposit automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantities and rates, and the subtotal, 25% deposit and balance due update automatically.

faqs.q: Is this legal or tax advice?
faqs.a: No. Templates are for informational purposes only. Requirements vary by state — verify with a CPA or attorney before use.
